title: The stability of m6A-marked transcripts is linked to cell identity in planarians.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO GSE325813 file list (75 files, 4.9 GB RAW.tar): 36 salmon quant.sf.gz files (~0.6 MB each) for the actinomycin D (transcription-blocking drug) time course (WT, unc22 RNAi, mettl14 RNAi x 0/6/12 h x 4 replicates) and 33 modkit bedMethyl pileup files of 120-284 MB each. Opened WT-0h-R1 quant.sf: 41,367 transcripts (h1SMcT IDs) with Length, TPM, NumReads. Ranged-read the first rows of a WT pileup: per-adenosine genome positions with coverage and percent modified, not a site list. Zenodo 22082929 holds only analysis code (MIT).
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: ~72,200 m6A sites, the 99% Dorado probability cutoff, the 316-gene stabilised cluster and the Supplementary Table S7 decay clusters; the NAR supplement could not be retrieved (Europe PMC timed out), so no curated site table or decay-rate table was opened.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO files are public with no login; checked the file list and downloaded one quant file. The pileups are over the 50 MB cap.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked in the files: no file has a per-site m6A label or a per-gene decay rate. Site labels must be built by thresholding 170-280 MB pileups, and decay rates must be fitted from 36 TPM (transcripts per million) tables across time points.

a3_inputs_present.note: Sequence would come from the schMedS3 planarian genome and transcriptome, which is a single public download rather than thousands of lookups.

a4_units_stated.note: Quant files use TPM and read counts; pileups use percent modified, per the modkit format.

a5_enough_rows.note: 41,367 transcripts per quant file (verified); ~72,200 sites is the paper's figure only.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: ~0.5-2 GB if pileups were streamed and filtered
a6_fits_laptop.note: Pileups would need streaming, but this is feasible on a laptop.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: The 72,200 site count was not checkable without building the site list; there was no contradiction among what was seen.

a8_label_provenance.note: m6A calls are the output of Dorado's neural-network modification caller (sup v5.0.0 m6A model) thresholded at 99%, so a sequence-to-m6A model would distil Dorado. Decay labels are measured, but only for clusters of hundreds of genes per the paper.

backbone.name: RNA-FM (an RNA language model) would fit sequence windows

integration.join_key: transcript ID (dd_v6 to schMedS3 needs remapping by minimap2)
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Do sequence features predict whether m6A stabilises or destabilises a transcript depending on cell type?

controls.positive_control: DRAYW motif enrichment and stop-codon proximity of called sites
controls.negative_control: mettl14 knockdown pileups (73% loss of global m6A)
controls.external_validation: None located for planarian; human or mouse m6A atlases are a different species.

honest_claim_h3: A model would predict where Dorado's neural network calls m6A in one clonal planarian line, not where m6A is independently measured.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use RNA sequence around adenosines to predict which ones carry the m6A chemical mark in planarian flatworms.
plain_idea.train_on: Sequence windows around adenosines in the planarian transcriptome; ~72,200 positive sites per the paper (not verified).
plain_idea.predict: Whether a site is methylated. The truth comes from nanopore direct RNA reads scored by Dorado's modification-calling neural network.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Planarian researchers could map m6A in transcripts not covered by sequencing. The label is another model's output, however, which limits what we would learn.

ml_idea: Sequence-to-m6A site classifier, or prediction of mettl14-dependent decay change per gene; neither label exists as a column, and the site label is a Dorado model prediction.

effort.compute_note: Estimated from file sizes only; nothing was timed.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Retrieve the NAR supplementary tables to see whether a curated site list or per-gene decay-rate table exists.

verdict_reason: A2 and A8 fail. The deposited files hold raw per-adenosine pileups and per-sample transcript abundances, with no site or decay-rate table, and the m6A labels are Dorado neural-network calls rather than an independent measurement.
